scope: Read-only correctness review of the added adult-course production tools and the unchanged shared media/player dependencies they call. Focus: course/source isolation, stale speech/practice rejection, five audio tracks/four translated CC/no English CC, complete current-source packaging, independent voice/CC controls, and separated practice answers. No repository changes or production operations performed.

observations: document_course validates top-level version, exact series title, course, every episode course, matching season/stage and absence of legacy grade.
require_output_course rejects an existing output resolution belonging to the other course before batch status/log creation.
Batch admission and worker completion require current source fingerprints plus recursive preservation of every authored field, then source-bound valid_final verification.
Renderer cache keys include course, stage, season, title and displayed text/reveal state; renderer profile binds course configuration, artwork dependencies, font files and recorded render library.
Preflight compares current authored fields including all reading, writing and answer text with the measured resolution; a claimed matching source hash cannot bypass the recursive comparison.

Shared source_fingerprint includes the entire authored episode and voice/rate/timing settings. Timing verification matches source-derived instruction and English-demo clip keys to measured PCM duration records.

Audio integrity checks source-bound sidecar hashes and final-bound receipts. Final verification binds actual bytes to the full-decode receipt and current renderer; picture verification checks source, renderer, bytes and hash.
Mux explicitly maps one picture stream, five locale audio streams and four non-English caption streams, records labels and runs full audio/video decode.

Final verification checks five AAC audio streams, four caption streams, exact locale metadata and no English caption language. Sidecar verification requires exactly five M4A masters and eight caption files.

Caption contents and timing are compared with resolved source, including hidden quiz translation before reveal and caption-free response intervals. The package file allowlist cannot include English SRT/VTT.
Packaging requires ordered ep01 through ep48 in the same course for both source and resolved documents, and the resolved argument must identify the output resolution actually verified.
It invokes fresh full verify_output and requires passed true; authoring-subset and partial reports cannot satisfy this condition.

All four season archives and the optional complete archive are staged from the explicit media allowlist, with fresh player, catalog and practice files; membership, uniqueness and CRC checks precede archive replacement.
Source and resolution hashes are rechecked before final replacement, and evidence records both hashes.
Adult adaptation preserves the shared playback logic and embeds the correct course/stage per episode. The picture video remains muted while the selected standalone locale audio plays.

Voice change loads only the selected M4A and restores playback position; CC change only selects embedded caption cues. CC options include four translations and off, with English offered only in the voice selector.
Caption JSON is embedded for local-file use and escaped against script termination. No actual browser playback was attempted in this review.
HTML accumulates all reading/writing activity pages separately and appends answers only after those activities.
PDF emits one cover and two activity pages per episode before entering a separate loop that emits all answer/model pages: 145 pages for 48 lessons and 37 pages for a 12-lesson season.
Reading and writing ranges come from the selected course; PDF text and writing-line overflow checks fail rather than silently clipping authored content.

verification_performed: Read added config/shared/profile/build/batch/verify/package/player/practice/objects/visuals code and inspected relevant existing regression coverage.
Traced called shared audio/build/verify/player/package functions to establish actual track mapping, hashes, timing and independent UI behavior.
Confirmed the reviewed working-tree adult and shared dependency files are byte-equivalent to committed f9880c40 using git diff --exit-code.
tests: No broad test reruns. Root reported the existing 40 adult checks and 2012 tools checks passed; this review does not claim to have rerun them.
limitations: This is a code review, not final delivery verification: complete generated assets and archive contents must retain their separate runtime evidence.
Actual browser playback and real printing were not exercised by this read-only review.
